title: lexsync: multidimensional lexical optimisation and hardware-timed experiment generation
description: A cross-platform (R and Python) toolkit that unifies many-language lexical-corpus access, parallel multidimensional stimulus matching, counterbalancing and the automated generation of hardware-timed PsychoPy and OpenSesame experiment scripts for EEG/ERP research. Distributed as a CRAN-ready R package and a PyPI-ready Python package that produce identical matched stimuli.
